note: Revisions to the REWILD entry in mockup-args.json, matching the current mockups (main.png, end.png, desktop.png), revision 4. Replace the named fields; everything else in the entry stands.
typography: Alegreya (serif, weight 600) is used for exactly three things: the goal line on the race strip, the win/loss headline on the end card, and the titles in the Tree panel ('The Tree' and the selected growth's name). Everything else is Alegreya Sans (500, 700 and 800): labels, counts, pills, buttons, the ticker and the facts, with tabular lining figures for the Seeds number. This replaces 'System sans-serif' in main_screen: the bookish serif and humanist sans carry the old-map warmth that the system face lacks. Both families are SIL Open Font License 1.1; the licence texts ship beside the font files (fonts/OFL-Alegreya.txt, fonts/OFL-AlegreyaSans.txt) and must be included in every build and in the app's credits. Continent names on the map follow one rule: Alegreya Sans 700 capitals, 10 px on phone and 12.5 px on PC, letter-spaced 0.2 em, set along a gentle arc; by day ink #22302A at 60% with a 2 pt cream halo, by night (inside the night band) cream at 85% with an ink halo. THE NORTH REACH sits on a patch of clean ice along the continent's south coast, kept free of pines and rock so the name reads.
main_screen_changes: THE WORLD: the same 6 continents and 42 regions, with organic coasts: the Old Heart has bays on its west, south and east coasts and a cape at Sefi, the North Reach has a broken, bumpy north coast, the Long Coast's north end no longer curls west, and the Glass Isles are five separate islands, two large (Glimmer, Merrin) and three small (Thessaly Rock, Tallis, Lune), one region each.

REGIONS: every region border is a 1 pt hand-inked line (#22302A, about 50% on grey land and 25% on green, with a faint cream halo either side so it reads on concrete). Every region shows one city mark at its city: on grey land a small cluster of grey blocks with lit roofs and shadowed sides on a paved apron; on green land the same footprint painted faintly under the canopy with three to five small lights.

PAINTING: forest is brushwork, crowns of two sizes warped off any grid, lit from the upper left, with diagonal brush texture and meadow clearings; turned farmland is a meadow mosaic with soft, lighter, broken hedgerows (no dark grid); pines are small directional strokes with a lit flank and a short shadow; every green front is led by scattered patches; the mowing fringe is grey cut stubble in mown rows that bites into the green with ragged teeth and leaves a dark cut face.

NIGHT BAND: the right 28% of the map lies under #0B1220 at 45%, bounded by a gently curved terminator (an arc of a large circle centred off the map to the east) with a soft gradient about 28 pt wide and no coloured line. It fades out above and below the world, so it never runs behind the speed pill, the ticker or the bottom bar. On its side, grey cities glow amber (#F2B33D, one tidy cluster each), turned cities show three to five teal pinpricks, and green coastlines carry a teal rim (#5FF2C8).

RIVERS: each river is one continuous tapered ribbon from a thread inland to its widest at the sea, #8FD694 with a soft glow over green land and slate over grey land; at night it only lifts slightly toward teal.

WORKS: running Works are grey halls with a smoking chimney (North Reach at Vell, Old Heart at Tarrowin and Haldane, Long Coast at Quayle). Rusted Works (Brannoch on the Long Coast, Brand in the Hook) are 18 to 20 pt with a 1.5 pt cream halo, a clear rust #A0522D chimney with a broken top, and vines climbing the chimney and spilling over the hall.

GREAT TREES: a lighter, warmer canopy (#58A452 to #D2EC9A) with pink and cream blossom flecks, a thin ink edge, a cast shadow to the lower right, and a soft dashed #8FD694 ring on the ground showing the area it holds (teal inside the night band).

WALLS: two closed 2 pt #EDE6D6 rings with post dots, each following the border of one worried region (Thrale and Ostery in the north of the Old Heart). NEXT WALL: Marrish's own border traced as a flickering dashed white line. SURROUNDED: Sefi keeps its soft pulsing green ring.

GEESE: a clean V of three cream geese (#F4EFE4) with ink outlines, dark heads and darker wing tips, about 10 pt across, flying along the dotted flyway from the Long Coast to the green speck in the North Reach. The PC preview uses the same sprite.

BOTTOM: the ticker moves to y692-720, leaving a clear gap above Grow's halo ring. The Seeds glyph is the creased almond seed, gold #F2B33D with a darker edge and a curved crease, the same symbol as the race-strip finish and every cost chip.
INFO ROW: a 32 px cream menu button at x16-48 (it holds settings, including the 'always day' switch); the time pill at x56-156; the speed pill at x224-374.
RACE STRIP right-end glyph: a street lamp (post, collar and lantern with a gold flame).
end_screen_changes: THE FINAL WORLD is the exact painting from play (same coastlines, rivers, region borders and city positions), every region turned, scaled to 0.78 so the land spans about x51-339 and y155-555, with no clipping.

COLOUR: the green painting at full strength; a warm dusk wash capped at 15% on the day side; no fog; the sea #78919B, slightly brighter than in play. The night band crosses the right third of the map, full height, with the same curved, line-free terminator: every city there glows teal and the green coasts carry the teal rim. This amber-to-teal image is the store and share shot.

A great tree at every city (42), in three kinds at 85-115% scale: tall conifers in the North Reach and the Hook's cold tip, flat-topped acacias on the Dry Belt, broad oaks elsewhere; each city's lights sit round the tree's base in teal. Every Works is rusted and overgrown with its cream halo.
Replay: a 96x28 cream pill centred directly under the map, x147-243, y572-600.

One cream card (x16-374, y610-726) holds the timeline and the facts. Timeline: the grey line is a dotted, sleeping baseline until the eye marker where the Clearing woke; it rises steeply while six Works run, its slope dropping as each one falls, and levels off at half height after the last; the green line ends at the top. The six rust-chimney markers sit on their actual dates (uneven), the three tree markers on the green line. Under a hairline rule, the three fact lines in 13 px, each with its marker icon.
New game pill x16-302, y736-786; Share circle x322-374, y735-787; the 'Same world, same start' link at y794-814.
desktop_layout:
LANDSCAPE PC / STEAM 1280x800 (Steam Deck native; 1280x720 letterboxes the same layout). The same light product as the phone: cream paper panels (#F4EFE4 at 94%, 1 px #22302A at 12% border, soft shadow) over the full-bleed slate sea #6F8790. No globe, no dark UI.

1. THE MAP: the same flat painted world as the phone, centred in the area left of the panel (x0-840) at scale 1.12, land spanning about x213-627 and y126-700, so the whole world is visible and the North Reach smoke clears the race strip. Same states, sprites, night band (curved, line-free, fading out above and below the world), region borders, city marks, continent names (12.5 px) and preview overlays as the phone.
2. TOP ROW (y10-104): menu button (40 px circle, x20) and the time pill ('Year 2' with a sun glyph, x70); the race strip centred over the map (x192-648): goal line in Alegreya 600 16 px, the race bar (428x32), and the captions '27 of 42 green' (#2F7D4F) and 'The Clearing' (#4A4C50) in Alegreya Sans 700 14 px; the speed pill (x668-824, 40 tall: pause, 1x, 2x, 4x).
3. TICKER: bottom left, x20-480, y752-786, leaf glyph and one line in 15 px.
4. ACTION TRAY: x492-828, y716-788: the Seeds count (almond seed glyph, '64' in 29 px, 'seeds' under it), Plant (48 px circle, sapling, count badge, 'Plant' and a P keycap) and Grow (78 px green circle rising above the tray, sprout, 'Grow' and a G keycap; a gold ring while the Tree is open).
5. THE TREE: a 440 px cream panel docked on the right (x840-1280, full height): title 'The Tree' (Alegreya 27 px), the rule 'Each growth makes the others cost more.', Esc keycap and close button; a key row under it (Grown: filled green; Ready: cream with a green ring and a gold dot; Need seeds: the same with a grey dot; Locked: pale and dashed) in 12.5 px. Section headers in 12 px letter-spaced capitals. One painted tree: Branches (loud) above, Reach on two long boughs, Roots (quiet) below the soil line as tapered, wandering, hand-drawn roots with rootlets. Each node is a 42 px circle (Spring 50 px) with one line icon: filled green when grown, cream with a green outline when available, pale (55% opacity) and dashed when locked. Node names in 13 px; cost chips in 12 px with the almond seed, gold when you can afford it now, grey when you cannot, dashed when locked. A green vine runs along every grown branch and root. No tags or captions on the tree itself. Selecting a node shows a detail card (x856-1264, y668-784): medallion, name (Alegreya 22 px), one line, tags (Quiet/Loud, the branch, 'On the map') and a Grow button with the cost; the live map previews it at once (for Long Migration: dotted gold flyways to the three grey Glass Isles, gold rings on the targets, and the same cream-goose V on the flyways).
6. INPUT: Space pauses, 1-4 set the speed, G opens the Tree, P plants, Esc closes; mouse wheel or +/- zooms the flat map and drag pans it. Gamepad (Steam Deck): the left stick pans, the right stick moves a cursor, A taps, Y opens the Tree, X plants.
